validation.scope: Full E integer software check; sampled T RTL check. No E RTL or mapped-netlist simulation claimed.

limitations: Only the CSP projection is integer; filtering, power, log and LDA remain floating point.
T-prefix RTL sampling is separate from complete E-session software arithmetic verification.
Cued left/right task evaluation is not a clinical or pure neural-intent validation.
No best bit width is selected from E-session performance.
No independent prospective dataset, clinical evaluation, or novelty claim.
Kernel counts exclude memory, all other processing, CPU and data delivery.
No placed/routed device area, timing, power, temperature or board measurement.
Original and processed participant signals, per-trial predictions and models are not distributed.
Parameters were fixed before E evaluation; new E-informed experiments must be labelled exploratory.
